record.question: Identify the Part of Speech of the word 'Hey' in: Hey! Look out.
record.explanation: Answer A: Interjection. The source italicizes “Hey!” as an exclamatory call; it is an interjection. Independent check: “Hey!” is an interjection used to attract attention. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/interjections. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
